about: What dynaface's pipeline returns for the test photos, the three-quarter sketch and the synthetic-head renders (the written ones in cheek/, the rest rendered in memory), so the cheek tests run on real landmarks without the models. Written by scripts/make_cheek_fixtures.py; don't edit by hand.
pixel_frame: Raw landmarks are [x, y] pixels of the full image as loaded, before any crop or flip (for a render, the raw render's own frame, the same as cheek/cheek_renders.json). Pipeline landmarks are pixels of the 1024 by 1024 crop that load_image(img, crop=True) made, with its scale: on a frontal face (pipeline.pose 'frontal') the pupil-anchored frontal crop, and on a quarter face (pipeline.pose 'quarter') the centered band crop, never flipped, with far_left (the far cheek is the subject's left), cheek_scale (H, the chin-to-canthus distance in crop pixels) and the far-cheek outline's rows by source (mask, contour, nose, edge) that the trace stored; a profile records its pose only. The frontal crop corrects the pupil distance for yaw only above +5 degrees, so a negative turn's crop is uncorrected and can leave landmarks outside it (yaw-30 and yaw-45): compare mirrored turns through the raw landmarks, never through the pipeline ones.
yaw_sign: Positive yaw, true or as SPIGA reports it, means the nose points toward the image's right (the subject's left). Checked: SPIGA's yaw and the nose offset carry the true yaw's sign on yaw10 +5.9, yaw15 +7.8, yaw20 +10.4, yaw25 +12.9, yaw30 +15.6, yaw35 +19.6, yaw40 +23.7, yaw42 +25.8, yaw45 +28.3, yaw48 +30.5, yaw50 +32.6, yaw55 +37.8, yaw60 +43.0, yaw65 +44.3, yaw-15 -5.1, yaw-30 -14.2, yaw-45 -25.6, yaw-50 -30.0, yaw45_hollow3 +28.4, yaw50_hollow3 +33.0, yaw45_bump3 +28.3, yaw45_pitch5 +27.5, yaw45_pitch10 +26.6, yaw45_pitch-5 +27.5, yaw45_hollow1.5 +28.9, yaw45_hollow4.5 +28.7.
cues: nose_offset: landmark 54's offset from the lateral canthi's midpoint along the pupil axis, in canthus spans, roll-corrected, positive toward the image's right; nose_offset_raw: the same on the image x axis alone, as the design probes measured it; eye_width_ratio: the narrower eye's corner-to-corner width over the wider one's. All from the raw landmarks.
